description.value: A welcoming community library in downtown Grand Forks offering free access to books, computers, printing, an Idea Lab & Think Tank, and equipment loans. It sits on the Trans-Canada cycling corridor through the Boundary region, giving touring cyclists a comfortable indoor stop with seating and connectivity. The library also serves as a satellite for Christina Lake with a monthly outreach location there.

raw_osm.name: Grand Forks & District Public Library
raw_osm.note: If you wish to use the Wi-Fi without entering the building at any time of day, the password is "2504423944". Alternatively, the Rotary Wi-Fi is also available in the entire downtown area, including at the library, 24-7-365.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the library's name, address (7342-5th Street, Grand Forks), phone (250-442-3944), and email (library@gfpl.ca), all matching OSM. The site is clearly active with a 2026 copyright and upcoming events listed. Wi-Fi is supported by the OSM internet_access=wlan tag and an unusually specific OSM note that includes the actual Wi-Fi password and describes 24/7 outdoor availability. The website mentions services like photocopier/printer/scanner, equipment loans, and meeting rooms, but does not mention bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or other cycling-specific amenities.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A free, public indoor space in Grand Forks with Wi-Fi, printing, and equipment loans that touring cyclists can use as a rest and connectivity stop along the Boundary region route.

wow_evidence: Downtown library with Idea Lab; ordinary library band.
blurb: Grand Forks' public library, with an Idea Lab and equipment loans.
